breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction: 'assume the bending moment M(x) is constant over the full span and equal to the peak value M = P L.' This directly perpetuates the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this incorrect instruction entirely, requiring the agent to use the actual varying bending moment M(x) = P(L - x) along the span. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
